title: 選取與複製設定更清楚易找
summary: 選取與複製有了獨立設定頁，常用開關一目了然，延遲調整需要時再展開。
highlights: 左側新增「選取與複製」，一般頁保留語言、登入啟動與文字辨識設定。
動作列延遲以目前數值呈現，點擊後才展開滑桿、數值輸入與還原預設。
自動複製以獨立卡片呈現，關閉時收起相關選項並保留既有偏好。
usage: 開啟 SnapBar 設定，選擇左側「選取與複製」即可調整，無需額外安裝或重新設定。

en.title: Find selection and copy settings more easily
en.summary: A dedicated Selection and copying page keeps key switches visible and expands delay controls only when needed.
highlights: Selection and copying now has a sidebar entry; General keeps language, startup, and text recognition settings.
Toolbar delay shows its current value; expand it to use the slider, enter a value, or reset to default.
Auto-copy has its own card, hiding related options when disabled while retaining your preferences.
en.usage: Open SnapBar settings and select Selection and copying in the sidebar. No extra installation or configuration is required.
